claims.statement: Commissioned in March 1481 by the monks of San Donato a Scopeto and left unfinished when Leonardo moved to Milan. The date of the commission is documented, the state of the underdrawing is a matter for study.

sources.cite: First chronology draft (Leonardo Chronology, 2026-10-09), entered from model recall. Basis stated in the draft: Contract of March 1481.

timeline.text: Commissioned in March 1481 by the monks of San Donato a Scopeto and left unfinished when Leonardo moved to Milan. The date of the commission is documented, the state of the underdrawing is a matter for study.

flags: The contract is recalled as March 1481. Confirm the day and the later reassignment of the commission.
